description: Team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats
notes: Update with 'scoop update ds-bot'. The bundled electron-updater feed is deleted at install time, so Settings -> About reports a failed update check every few hours; that is expected.

Models, bots and chats live in %USERPROFILE%\.ds-bot, the bot workspace in %USERPROFILE%\DS Bot and logs in %APPDATA%\DS Bot. Nothing is written to the install directory, so 'scoop update' keeps your data.
The app bundles its own DSH runtime: about 1.2 GB installed, 291 MiB download. Neither Node.js nor dsh is required.
The upstream installer is unsigned; this manifest unpacks it instead of running it, so no SmartScreen or UAC prompt appears.
Uninstall leaves %USERPROFILE%\.ds-bot, %USERPROFILE%\DS Bot and %APPDATA%\DS Bot behind.
